text: Command, this is Guardhouse. All clear. Out.
source_text: Command, this is Guardhouse. All clear. Out.

text: Halt. This restricted area. You no be here.
source_text: Halt. This restricted area. You no be here.

text: You stop. Me take to Lieutenant. Come peaceful or die.
source_text: You stop. Me take to Lieutenant. Come peaceful or die.

text: I've come to talk to your master.
source_text: I've come to talk to your master.

text: I'm a special mutant on a mission for your master. Let me pass or face the consequences.
source_text:
I'm a special mutant on a mission for your master.
 Let me pass or face the consequences.

text: I'm with the Cathedral. Let me by.
source_text: I'm with the Cathedral. Let me by.

text: Fine. To the death it is.
source_text: Fine. To the death it is.

text: Good. Come with me, no laugh-type stuff.
source_text: Good. Come with me, no laugh-type stuff.

text: Laugh-type stuff? But you're gonna look so funny when I box you up!
source_text: Laugh-type stuff? But you're gonna look so funny when I box you up!

text: If you lie, me kill you.
source_text: If you lie, me kill you.

text: Uh, fine. I guess. Maybe you better see Lieutenant.
source_text: Uh, fine. I guess. Maybe you better see Lieutenant.

text: You killed my brother. I will have my revenge!
source_text: You killed my brother. I will have my revenge!

text: 命令，这是警卫室。消灭所有敌人。
source_text: 命令，这是警卫室。消灭所有敌人。

text: 站住。这是禁区。你不能来这。
source_text: 站住。这是禁区。你不能来这。

text: 停下。带我去见中尉。要么接受和平要么死路一条。
source_text: 停下。带我去见中尉。要么接受和平要么死路一条。

text: 我是来向你们主教报告的。
source_text: 我是来向你们主教报告的。

text: 我是你们主教指派的特派员。让我通过否则后果自负。
source_text: 我是你们主教指派的特派员。让我通过否则后果自负。

text: 我是大教堂的。让我通过。
source_text: 我是大教堂的。让我通过。

text: 好笑吗？当我打得你满地找牙的时候，你会看起来更好笑！
source_text: 好笑吗？当我打得你满地找牙的时候，你会看起来更好笑！

text: 如果你说谎，我就宰了你。
source_text: 如果你说谎，我就宰了你。

text: 呃，很好。我想也许你更想见中尉。
source_text: 呃，很好。我想也许你更想见中尉。

text: 你杀了我的兄弟。我要报仇！
